title: Sliding Window & Two Pointers

views.title: Sliding Window & Two Pointers
views.intro: Variable window: grow right, shrink left while invalid. "Longest valid" updates after the shrink; "shortest valid" updates inside the shrink loop; "count subarrays" uses atMost(k) - atMost(k - 1). Two pointers on sorted data move the pointer that cannot improve.

files.desc: Longest unique substring, character replacement, minimum window, min subarray length, K distinct, exactly K, ones III, anagrams, 2Sum/3Sum, container, dedupe, merge

pitfalls: Sliding window with negatives breaks the "shrink" logic; use prefix sums + map or a deque instead.
3Sum: skip duplicates for the fixed element AND after recording a triple.
Minimum window: track `missing` as a count so validity is O(1) per step.
